Change has been successfully rebased and submitted as c9bd09240cfa156ca348848ad6402b1d390bbfa1

Like below (what this is based on) assumes "/xyz/openbmc_project/software/" + *swId, 
This assumes "/xyz/openbmc_project/software/". If we want we make a mapper call but I find this reasonable.

Shouldn't this at least be: /xyz/openbmc_project/software/ *swId

It seems reasonable to assume they're implemented by the same path, but I don't quite understand the path mismatch.
I am following what https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/phosphor-bmc-code-mgmt/+/70698 did.. I added Adriana.
Cool, hopefully Adriana knows what's going on here.

I think it makes sense to move it under /swId. Initially I thought it would be less cumbersome to find the info under just the software/ path, but bmcweb already has access to the current swId, and the min version is tied to the firmware image running on the system. I'll make the change to move it under /swId.
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/phosphor-bmc-code-mgmt/+/72323
Done

Given that we support multiple update targets now, putting this information at UpdateService level doesn't seem appropriate.  This would be the information for THIS bmc, not all components in the system.

Can we attach it to the firmware inventory target instead?
Done. https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/phosphor-bmc-code-mgmt/+/72323 did that for the backend
sdbusplus::messages::operator/= please for constructing user (read attacker) driven dbus IDs.
Done

We should add Minimum version here, right?  And get minimum version from the minimum version service, and version from the version service?

Otherwise if a service only implemented MinimumVersion (which I agree, is odd) this wouldn't work right.

So I went back and forth here, and I can add if you think we should support this case ( only implemented MinimumVersion but no version). But I lean towards no, we don't support this odd case.

We already don't support this for getSwUpdatableStatus (xyz.openbmc_project.Software.Update), getRedfishSwHealth, getRedfishSwState, etc. And https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/79207/15/redfish-core/lib/update_service.hpp#906 (xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Decorator.Asset) isn't doing this either. 

So you have to implement a https://github.com/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/blob/master/yaml/xyz/openbmc_project/Software/Version.interface.yaml for your software to show up here, this has the software purpose, etc. Other interfaces like xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Decorator.Asset, xyz.openbmc_project.Software.MinimumVersion, Software.Update are optional and populate other properties.

This follows what we do for inventory (you want a fan, implement "xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Item.Fan" or a Chassis, implement https://github.com/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/blob/master/yaml/xyz/openbmc_project/Inventory/Item/Chassis.interface.yaml. State, Health, Location, PartNumber/SerialNumber/SubModel are optional interfaces https://github.com/openbmc/bmcweb/blob/99ff0ddcc083c149d3a64190e6c1b0caab1d77f2/redfish-core/lib/fan.hpp#L384

Redfish says you could have a software inventory without a version or purpose, but have it be updatable or a MinimumVersion but Redfish requires so few properties, I don't take much stock in that so until we hear otherwise, I vote we go as wrote 

           "required": [
                "@odata.id",
                "@odata.type",
                "Id",
                "Name"
            ],

https://redfish.dmtf.org/schemas/v1/SoftwareInventory.v1_11_0.json
Can add it later, but I prefer the existing pattern.

Not your fault, but this is an instance of a common error
